Connor White, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report and committee

14. ORDINANCE -2 READING ~ Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of
Cheyenne changing the zoning classification from MUB Mixed-Use Business and CB
Community Business to CB Community Business for land located between Old Happy
Jack Road and Lincolnway, west of Missile Drive. (SPONSOR - MR. COOK)

Mr. Laybourn moved to approve on 2™ reading, seconded by Mr. Segrave. Motion carried by
unanimous voice vote.

Seth Lloyd, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report and Brad Emmons, AVI
P.C., provided additional information. Committee member Rinne commented on the item.

15, RESOLUTION — Authorizing the Mayor and the City Clerk to sign a Final Plat for Dell
Range Addition, Sixth Filing, a replat of a portion of Tract 25, Dell Range Addition, City
of Cheyenne, Laramie County, Wyoming (located southwest of the intersection of Ridge
Road and Holland Court). (POSTPONED FROM 02-13-23)

Mr. Segrave moved to adopt, seconded by Dr. Rinne. Motion carried with Dr. Rinne and Mr.
Segrave voting “YES” and Mr. Laybourn voting “NO”.

Seth Lloyd, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report and Brad Emmons, AVI
P.C., provided additional information. Committee members Laybourn and Rinne commented on
the item.

A recess was called following the vote on item #15 at 1:50 p.m. and the meeting was reconvened
at 1:56 p.m,

21. | RESOLUTION — Certifying the Cheyenne Transit Program 2023 Transit Development
Plan. (SPONSOR ~ MR. COOK)

Dr. Rinne excused himself from the meeting at 2:30 p.m., prior to a motion or a vote on item #21,
due to a previous work engagement.

Mr. Segrave moved to adopt, seconded by Mr. Laybourn. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Vicki Nemecek, Public Works Director, provided a staff report and Renee Jording, Transit
Director, provided additional information. A.T. Stoddard, LSC Transportation Consultants, Inc.,
provided a presentation. Committee members Laybourn and Segrave commented on the item.
Public comments were made by Joe Dougherty and Marion Yoder.
